d:
Mokama se vidhayak anant sinh ki beti shivangi sinh ki shadi ko lekar unke paitrik ganv ladma men bhavy star par taiyariyan chal rahi hain. aagami 25 navanbar ko hone vali is shadi ki charcha pure bihar men ho rahi hai. anuman ke mutabik, is vivah samaroh men 4 lakh se adhik mehmanon ke shamil hone ki sanbhavna hai aur iske lie karoron rupye ki lagat se bhavy intjam kie ja rahe hain.
Jaypur ke patrakar chauk, lal kila aur hava mahal ki thim par bhavy pandal aur stej
